blocks.title: The Trade
blocks.text: Encapsulation and per-instance state, paid for with heap-allocated environments and a lifetime longer than the call.

blocks.title: One-Line Mental Model
blocks.text: A closure is a function that remembers where it was born, not where it was called.

blocks.title: Style Choice
blocks.text: Pick one style per codebase. Consistency beats preference.

caption.text: Part 2 of JS CLOSURES & SCOPE. Every JavaScript bug that starts with "but it logged 3 three times" is the same bug: closures capture bindings, not values. These 10 pages are the full field notes — scope chains, the var/let/const table, the two-phase hoisting model, the TDZ error messages decoded, the loop capture problem with all three fixes, IIFEs, the module pattern, and the leak patterns that follow closures around. Save it for the next time an error says "Cannot access 'x' before initialization" and you know exactly what to check.
